faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about ordering, warranty, and delivery in Lebanon.
faq.q1: How does delivery work across Lebanon?
faq.a1: We operate as a 100% online store with daily nationwide dispatch! Our courier delivers straight to your doorstep across all Lebanese regions (Beirut, Mount Lebanon, Tripoli, Sidon, Tyre, Bekaa, Jounieh, etc.) within 24 to 48 hours.
faq.q2: How does Cash on Delivery (COD) work?
faq.a2: You can pay in USD cash directly to our delivery courier upon receiving and inspecting your sealed package. No pre-payment or credit card is required.
faq.q3: Are all products brand new, authentic, and sealed?
faq.a3: 100% guaranteed. Every device sold at Agha Tech plus is original, brand new, factory sealed, inspected, and delivered in our custom branded packaging with local warranty.
faq.q4: What does the 1-Year Local Warranty cover?
faq.a4: Our local warranty covers manufacturing defects, hardware failures, and component replacements. Repairs are handled locally in Lebanon by certified brand technicians.
faq.q5: Can I request a custom PC build or ask for specific product stock?
faq.a5: Absolutely! Our live WhatsApp tech concierge is available 6 days a week to provide custom PC part configurations, pricing quotes, and stock verification in real time.
